meta.title: LanPaste - Copy here. Paste there.
meta.description: A clipboard for the computers on your desk. Sync Mac and Windows over your own network. No account, no cloud.
hero.headline: Copy here. Paste there.
hero.sub: A clipboard for the computers on your desk. Same Wi-Fi, no account, nothing leaves your network.
types.headline: Find it, preview it, paste it.
types.body: One shortcut opens a searchable history. Mixed types sit on a single timeline. Enter pastes into the app you were using.
types.imageBody: Copied images land in history with a thumbnail. Select, preview, paste.
types.fileBody: The other machine sees the name and size. Bytes move only when you paste.
types.codeBody: URLs, tokens, and the paragraph you copied ten minutes ago. Type to filter.
privacy.headline: Private because it never leaves the room.
privacy.body: LanPaste has no account and does not talk to any server. Paired machines exchange clipboard items on your Wi-Fi or wired network. Pair in front of both screens. Use it on a network you trust.
privacy.point1: No cloud, no relay, no signup
privacy.imageAlt: Two laptops on a desk with a local router between them
setup.headline: Install on both. Pair once. Copy as usual.
setup.installBody: Put LanPaste on each Mac or Windows machine. It stays in the menu bar or tray.
setup.pairBody: Nearby devices appear in Settings. Add the other machine and type the 6-digit code on its screen.
setup.pasteBody: Copy on one computer. Search or paste on the other. Each pair is remembered until you remove it.
setup.imageAlt: Pairing window showing a six-digit code on a laptop
download.headline: Take the short way.
download.body: Free to download. Unsigned for now, so the OS may ask you to allow it on first launch.
download.macGate: Mac: System Settings, Privacy and Security, Open Anyway. Or Control-click the app and choose Open.
download.winGate: Windows: if SmartScreen appears, choose More info, then Run anyway.
download.error: Could not reach GitHub. Use All releases to pick a file.
footer.tagline: Copy on this computer. Paste on the other one.
